name: The Wellesley Knightsbridge
positioning: The Wellesley Knightsbridge, a Luxury Collection Hotel: an Art Deco-style hotel in the former Hyde Park Corner Tube station, immediately adjacent to Hyde Park
best_for: Travelers who want a Knightsbridge base right beside Hyde Park
Guests who value butler service and a building with real history
Groups or families wanting a large multi-bedroom penthouse with Hyde Park views

facts.text: The hotel is on Knightsbridge, immediately adjacent to Hyde Park.
The building began its life as the Hyde Park Corner Tube station.
The building is the former home of the jazz and cabaret venue Pizza on the Park.
The hotel is named after Sir Arthur Wellesley, the first Duke of Wellington.
The design by Fox Linton Associates is a modern take on the Art Deco style that acknowledges the building's jazz legacy.
The Park View Suites, Junior Suites and One Bedroom Suites, offer views over Hyde Park.
The bathrooms use veined Arabescato Corchia marble hand-selected in Italy and have televisions recessed into mirrored walls.
The concierge team is Les Clefs d'Or and can help create a bespoke itinerary.
The two bedroom Family Suite includes children's robes, slippers and bathroom amenities, and babysitting can be arranged with the concierge.
The Oval Restaurant serves refined Italian cuisine from fresh, seasonal ingredients.
The Crystal Bar's walls display whisky, cognac and Armagnac collections, including some extremely rare bottles from 1770.

highlights.text: The original Tube station facade remains part of the hotel, and the ox-blood tiles on the front of the building are the originals.
The Wellesley Penthouse occupies the sixth and seventh floors and can be booked as a one, two or four bedroom option.
The Churchill Suite, part of the Penthouse, has its own winding staircase to a private terrace with rooftop views over Belgravia.
A 24-hour butler service, including unpacking, pressing and shoe shining, is complimentary to all guests.
The heated Cigar Terrace has leather seats and a bespoke humidor of fine cigars.

considerations.text: Parking is off-site, at a nearby Q Park.
Rooms do not have a fridge.
